title: Public Tender Finder + Bid Writer
summary: Small companies miss public contracts and take days to write bids. Daily matches, 1-page summaries and AI bid drafts.
hook: "There was a €200K cleaning contract with our city. We found out after the deadline."
story:
**A 25-person IT consultancy** could win public contracts (municipalities, hospitals, agencies), but finding the right tenders means checking multiple portals every day, and the documents are 80+ pages.

When they do find one, writing the bid takes the owner **3–5 days**: company description, references, CVs, methodology, compliance forms. Most of it is the same content as last time, rewritten. So they bid rarely and **miss most opportunities**.

whyReal.title: Huge amount of money
whyReal.text: Public procurement is a large share of EU GDP, with thousands of new tenders every week.

whyReal.title: Small companies are under-represented
whyReal.text: Finding and writing bids is the barrier, not ability.

whyReal.title: AI is good at this
whyReal.text: Matching tenders to a company profile and drafting from past bids are strong LLM tasks.

whyReal.title: But: established players exist
whyReal.text: Tender alert services and AI bid tools already exist in several countries, so we need a niche.

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: small companies (5–100 staff) that can sell to the public sector: IT, cleaning, construction, consulting, training.

whoPays.label: Niche idea
whoPays.text: one country + one sector first (e.g. Romanian IT firms, or Swedish facility services).

solution.title: Profile
solution.text: describe the company once: services, regions, references, certifications.

solution.title: Match daily
solution.text: we scan tender portals (e.g. EU TED + national portals) and send only relevant tenders with a match score.

solution.title: Summarise
solution.text: AI turns an 80-page tender into a 1-page summary: requirements, deadline, budget, red flags.

solution.title: Go / no-go
solution.text: a checklist of whether you meet the requirements.

solution.title: Draft bid
solution.text: AI drafts the answer sections from past bids and the company profile.

timeline.what: **Validate.** Pick one country and sector. Manually send 10 companies a weekly list of matching tenders with AI summaries. Do they open it? Do they bid?
Checklist and first paying users; bid drafting later.

competitors.name: Tender alert services (e.g. Mercell, Tendium, national services)
competitors.gap: Often generic, pricey or limited to certain countries

risks.answer: Pick a niche where nobody is focused (country × sector).
Customers may not win quickly; show value through time saved and tenders found.

questions: Do you bid on public tenders today? How many per year?
How long does writing one bid take you?
Have you missed a tender you could have won? Why?
What would you pay to never miss a relevant tender?
